name: Unbreakable Sorrow
description: The PCs hear the sound of sobbing and feel an overwhelming sense of sorrow, as if they'd lost something more precious to them than their own life.
disable: DC 32 Deception or DC 32 Performance (master) to laugh away the sadness, DC 31 Occultism (expert) to banish the psychic imprint, DC 33 Thievery (master) to disperse the emotional energy

defensiveAbilities.name: Mourn
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches the statue

Effect The trap deals (4d10+14) Mental Damage damage to all creatures in the room (Basic DC 28 Will Saving Throw save). On a failed save, a creature additionally falls Prone and begins to weep, taking 1d10 Persistent,mental Damage damage.
